title: How does a gear make a small motor strong?
note: The demo episode. It shows how an episode's files fit together and renders with no API key (estimated timing, no audio). It is deliberately simple and is NOT a quality reference: real episodes follow docs/QUALITY.md.

lines.text: Your drill's motor is the size of your thumb.
But it still drives a screw into hardwood.
So where does the strength come from?
The motor spins a tiny gear, very fast.
That gear turns a big one, five times its size.
The big gear turns five times slower, and five times harder.
So your motor was never strong.
It just traded speed for force.
Your Brand. Free on the App Store.
